body.text: b review of keys.rs/login.rs JS: no XSS or secret-echo bugs found. All server strings (provider/label/last4/prefix/agent_id/uses/countdown) go through kesc; fake key is set via textContent only, never concatenated into HTML; ks-value cleared on success and error paths and never rendered; revoke uses index into fakeKeys not a string in markup; safeNext blocks // open-redirect. Minor/non-blocking: (1) drawFake() rebuilds innerHTML every 1s, so a Revoke click landing mid-rebuild can be dropped — consider updating only countdown text; (2) dead_code warnings because lib.rs doesn't call p5 yet (orchestrator wiring). tests.rs is written: 7 tests, all pass under acceptance.
